about: The one source of the figures the project's site shows (ADO2, #671). Each figure says what it measures, its date (the day or the month of the measure) and its source: a file of the repository, the sentence of it that gives the figure (quote), and the heading it sits under (anchor) or the run it comes from (run). scripts/adoption.py and tests/unit/test_adoption.py refuse a figure without its date or its source, a source the repository does not hold, a quote its file no longer says, and a figure on a page that is not here. kind: measured, estimate, setting (a value of the code or of its configuration), to-remeasure (a measure taken before the current architecture, to be replayed).

wrong_disruptive.says: isolations and blocks judged wrong, of those judged, over 30 days on the bench and on a bench VM that carries a real workload

blocked_alone.says: blocks of SSH brute force from the Internet that Glorfindel made alone, in one weekend, on a bench VM that carries a real workload

source.quote: 5 blocages autonomes sur bree le week-end du 01/11

shadow_contained.says: attacks detected over 30 days that Glorfindel would have contained alone, in observation (it acted on none)

source.quote: Glorfindel would have contained 3 of the 5 attacks it detected (shadow)

detect_median.says: median time to detect an attack on the bench, over 30 days

source.quote: detection in 107 s and a decision in 2 min (medians)

detect_range.says: time to detect a first attack on the bench, from the quickest run to the slowest

coverage.says: implemented techniques proven over the last 30 days on the bench

source.quote: 4 of the 5 implemented techniques proven in the last 30 days

last_e2e.says: the last run that proved detection and response end to end, on the bench (a technique and a declared fault in one campaign)

source.quote: dernier run de bout en bout : 31/10 (BL1, T1136.001, banc)

proof_flag.says: the age past which the console shows the last proof in red (amber from three weeks)

source.quote: vert sous 21 jours, jaune jusqu'à 30, rouge au-delà ou aucune

model_harness.says: harness cases decided right by the model in service, and none wrong with high confidence

injection_logs.says: decisions diverted by an attacker's instruction planted in a log line (four cases, three draws each, the model of the time)

injection_memory.says: decisions flipped by a memory full of exercises, or by a past cycle that carries an instruction

kill_switch.says: from revoking the injectors' host identity to its first refused call, the attack side's emergency stop (one measure)

source.quote: révocation effective en moins de 3 s (une seule mesure)

fault_mistaken.says: declared fault taken for an attack, on the bench (a single fault so far)

source.quote: une panne prise pour une attaque comptée à part (0 sur 1 au banc)

contain_ransom.says: to contain a ransomware VM, Glorfindel acting alone
contain_ransom.note: a run from before the hosted watch, Orodruin and Dagorlad; to be replayed on the bench

source.quote: ~1 min to contain a ransomware VM

restore_ransom.says: from the ransomware's first action to the service restored from backup
restore_ransom.note: a run from before the hosted watch, Orodruin and Dagorlad; to be replayed on the bench

hosted_chain.says: from an attack on the bench to its card in Discord, with Glorfindel on its own hosted VM

source.quote: chaîne complète jusqu'à Discord en ~2 min

host_cost.says: the reference host of Glorfindel, running all the time, before its disk and address

model_cost.says: the model's calls for one attack run on the bench

memory_age.says: the oldest past decision the model is shown from the local memory, and only real ones, never exercises
